name: tsa_createReturnSession
description: Opens a new 90-day TSA.Session for an existing Active worker (returning user who lost the session cookie). Intended to run after tsa_validateOtp returned the workerId; the SP itself does not check that an OTP was verified. Currently unused while the app runs the tsa_loginByPhone bypass. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'createReturnSession' to [TSA].[tsa_createReturnSession]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: workerId
parameters.description: Worker id returned by tsa_validateOtp. No default.

columns.name: sessionId
columns.description: New TSA.Session.id for the httpOnly cookie.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Worker not found or not Active (line 30, 'Worker account not found or suspended.') or CATCH (line 46). Two columns only.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed user-facing text, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block (raw SQL Server text).

sideEffects: INSERT TSA.Session (one row, expiresAt = now + 90 days).

codeSmells.detail: @workerId (line 2) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.
The CATCH (lines 44-47) returns the error envelope but writes nothing to HC.ErrorLog or any TSA log table, so failures are only visible in Azure Function logs as a 400 warning.

codeSmells.issue: Trusts the caller for proof of identity
codeSmells.detail: Any caller holding a worker id gets a 90-day session; the OTP check lives only in the Next.js route.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
